claims: The Artemis II mission is estimated to cost over $4 billion per launch.
NASA's lunar program is expected to exceed $100 billion in total funding by 2025.
The per launch cost for Artemis II is ~$4.1 to $4.2 billion.
The Orion crew capsule is projected to cost $9.3 billion through the second flight.
Development of the SLS rocket has exceeded $24 billion since 2010.
The entire Artemis campaign is projected to cost around $93 billion.
Each launch involves assembling the SLS.
The SLS uses parts from the retired Space Shuttle program.
The Orion capsule costs approximately $1 billion.
The service module is provided by the European Space Agency.
Ground systems cost ~$568 million per year.
